children: Gold held around $4,350 an ounce on Wednesday after sliding for two straight sessions, pressured by rising oil prices that heightened inflation concerns and strengthened expectations for interest rate hikes.
Oil prices continued to climb after US forces destroyed five Iranian crude tankers near Kharg Island, the country’s main oil export hub, in retaliation for attempted missile attacks on a US warship.
Investors also braced for key US inflation readings this week for further signals on the Federal Reserve’s next policy move.
Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 60% chance of a 25-basis-point rate hike next week.
Although gold is widely considered a hedge against inflation, higher interest rates can reduce demand for the non-yielding asset by increasing the appeal of interest-bearing investments.
Meanwhile, gold posted strong gains in August, supported by increased investment and hedging demand, along with continued central bank purchases, particularly from China.

title: Gold Holds Losses as Oil Prices Rise
